[[Alari's Double Blades]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, these daggers are replicas of the ones [[Alari Doubleblade]] wields.

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:Health +30
